title: Marquesan language
description: Polynesian language spoken in the Marquesas of French Polynesia
extract: Marquesan is a collection of East-Central Polynesian dialects, of the Marquesic group, spoken in the Marquesas Islands of French Polynesia. They are usually classified into two groups, North Marquesan and South Marquesan, roughly along geographic lines.
